_calibration: Live wording seen 2026-09-13: 'notify ... in writing within fifteen (15) calendar days of its receipt' (one customer MSA, MATCH); 'within three (3) calendar days of its receipt' (another, DEVIATION). Basis is receipt of invoice, not invoice DATE — §16 says 'of the invoice date'; recorded, not assumed equivalent.

2026-09-13: cap phrases narrowed to the dispute sentence; a paragraph that states several periods (payment, interest, dispute) is a known extraction limit — the first quantity in the clause body is read (44.24 forbids choosing), so a multi-period paragraph falls to a person unless the dispute sentence stands alone, as it does in the live MSAs.
2026-09-13: plural/participle forms added — a term matches at word boundaries, so 'dispute' never matched 'disputes' (found reproducing §16's Company Position paragraph).
